Yes, Yes I Love You CapCut Template

Yes, Yes I Love You CapCut Template-Currently, a video is going viral on Instagram where a boy or girl is making a heart shape with their hands while song lyrics appear on the screen. Many people are creating this type of video, whether they are boys or girls. The reason is that these videos are getting lots of likes, comments, and shares when posted on Instagram. Many people also want to create this Trending Video using their own raw footage. But editing this type of video manually requires a lot of time and editing skills. Maybe you don’t have those editing skills, which is why you are reading this article. In this article, I will help you create this video easily. That’s why I have brought you the Yes, Yes I Love You CapCut Template. Using this template, you can easily create Trending Love Status Reels with your own video. So, let’s see how to use this template to create your own video.

Unlimited Prompt   

About Yes, Yes I Love You CapCut Template

This is a Trending Video Editing Template in which the model creates a beautiful heart shape using both hands. Along with this lovely pose, the lyrics of the song “Yes, Yes I Love You” appear over the heart shape. The main reason behind this template’s popularity is its Slow Motion Effect and Lyrics Animation. When the model creates a love shape with their hands, the slow-motion effect makes the entire video look more beautiful and romantic. You can also use your own raw video to create Reels in the same style. You don’t need to do any editing manually. Just use the CapCut Template, and your video will be ready. So, let’s learn how to create this video. By following the steps and using the correct template link, you can easily make a similar video too.

Best Way To Shoot Video For Use This Template?

You are about to click the Template Link and use the template, but you don’t have a good Raw Clip ready. In that case, your final video may not look perfect because the video you add to the template needs to be shot properly. If you don’t know how to shoot the video, I’ve explained the steps below.

1. Keep your phone or camera in a stable position so that it doesn’t move while recording. You can use a tripod if you have one.

2. Stand in front of the camera or adjust its position so that your upper body, from your chest to your head, is clearly visible. Try to look straight at the camera.

3. Now, use both hands to create a beautiful Heart Shape. Make sure your hand pose is clearly visible in the camera.

By shooting the video this way, your Raw Video will be ready. Try to keep the video around 6 to 7 seconds long. Now, you can easily create your video using this Raw Video with the help of the CapCut Template.

Use Capcut Template

Learn How To Use Yes, Yes I Love You Template ?

Your Raw Video is now ready, so there is nothing else to worry about. All you need to do is use the template. You don’t have to manually add any Lyrics, Transitions, or Effects. Everything will be added automatically. You can find the Template Link above. Simply click on it and follow the steps below.

1. First, download the CapCut app from the Play Store or Chrome.

2. Now, click on the Template Link I have provided.

3. After clicking the link, a page will open where you will see a Use Template button. Click on it.

4. The CapCut app will open. Now, select and add your Raw Video from your gallery.

5. Once your video is added, click on the Next option. All the Effects, Lyrics, and Transitions will be applied automatically.

6. Your video is now ready! Finally, click on the Export button to save your edited video to your gallery.

Download My Apk

Conclusion

So, that’s how you can easily create your own Yes, Yes I Love You CapCut Template video. You don’t need any editing skills or have to spend time adding effects manually. Just record a good Raw Video, use the template, and your video will be ready in a few clicks! If you enjoyed this template, don’t forget to share your video on Instagram Reels, Facebook, or YouTube Shorts. Also, let me know in the comments how your video turned out.
